plan: 1. Load data.csv. 2. Apply age filter: keep age between 18 and 80 inclusive. 3. Drop rows with missing biomass or bmi. 4. Code treatment as 1=fertilised,0=unfertilised. 5. Fit OLS: biomass ~ treatment + age + bmi + baseline, non-robust SEs. 6. Extract n, coef_exposure (treatment), se_exposure, p_exposure, coef_age, r_squared, adj_r_squared. 7. Print JSON.
